GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (20 May 47) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1694)
APO 500
20 May 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminals.
The following named Japanese will be apprehended as Suspected War Criminals and delivered to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest possible date.
NAME RANK OR TITLE PERTINENT DATA
IMAMURA, Iwao Lt Comdr Commanding Officer 12 Naval Construction Unit, Kavieng (New Ireland), June 1942 - Oct 1943. Probable Home Address: #1 Kanaya-machi, Nagasaki City, Nagasaki Prefecture. c/o Yamanaka, Isao.
NAGATANI, Katsuhiro WO 1st Stn, Kempei Tai, South Area, French Indo China, 1945. Home Address: Near Kobe Area.
SHIMIZU, Shigeji (alias TANAKA Shigeji) Civ Guard Nagoya Camp #3 Funatsu, Honshu, June 1944-19 Sep 1945. Imp Jap Army in China Jan 1938-Apr 1942. Probable Home Address: Kagawa-ken, Takamatsu, shi, Hon-machi. Employed at Hida Goban Company.
TOKEN, Hachiro Sgt/Maj 9th Lines of Communication Garrison Guard Unit, Muntok Bangka Island, Sumatra, Apr-Sep 1944. Repatriated on Choran Maru 8 Jan 1947.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
